first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The spacesuited person in the foreground on the image-right, with a face visible inside the transparent visor, a striped shoulder-sleeve patch, and a large white rectangular backpack partially out of frame.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The spacesuited person on the image-left, with a circular shoulder patch, a white backpack bearing a black rectangular marking, a black circular opening, and a short red strip, and a blue-gray display surface on the forearm extending toward the center.

entities.name: silver-gray gridded metal panel assembly
entities.identification: The rectangular assembly between the two people, containing a light-colored horizontal-bar grille on a black background, a silver-gray panel surface, a small rectangular cover, and a thin orange rod along the side.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The background of blue surface and white cloud patterns visible behind the people and equipment.

entities.name: black-gray angular equipment box
entities.identification: The dark faceted equipment box in the lower-left foreground, with a wide light-colored edge and a metal ring-shaped piece, its lower part cut off by the frame.
